name: Dog Fire Rescue
steps: Tap the sleeping man to wake him up.
Tap fish tank to pour water on fire.
Tap Pokéball to release Squirtle water attack.
Tap puppy to release sweat water.
Tap soda can to pour liquid on fire.
Tap cat litter box to cover fire.
Tap metal pot to smother flames.
Tap water dispenser to dump water.
Tap magic staff to cast water spell.
Tap door to call firefighter and stop fire.
